budgetAssumptions: Normal mode has 900 start credits and 80+4n wave reward; half-cash multiplies both by 0.5. Upgrade estimates assume pathFactor=1, real factors and bounty are unknown. No hidden income is applied by runner.

scenarios.composition: Dual-center needle/scatter, orchard, beacon, northern rail and southern mortar
scenarios.risk: Bosses at 40/60 require sufficient shield and phase DPS; still unverified.
countermeasures: Frost at eastern merge slows fast southern groups
Rail at north gantry targets armor/boss
Tesla and mortar distribute splash and shield damage
Orchard is only a tentative economy investment

scenarios.composition: Cheap needle opener on two fronts, delayed scatter/frost, boss rail, rear mortar
scenarios.risk: Requires real cash payouts from enemy layers; opening second needle on wave 2 depends on wave 1 bounty.
countermeasures: Distribute cheap needle damage before scaling
Use frost to buy firing time at merge
Save for rail penetration instead of farm income

scenarios.composition: No selling, farms or knowledge; early central defense, detection, frost and separate shield rail
scenarios.risk: One life; any leak loses immediately, target timings require a live engine replay.
countermeasures: Observatory at north yard detects cloaked enemies
Frost on the merge slows fast entrants
Rail pierces armor while Tesla damages shields
No farm, sale or knowledge assumptions
